page.overview:
What is Twisted Freddy?

is one of the four twisted animatronics and an antagonist in Five Nights at Freddy's: The Twisted Ones. He is the twisted incarnation of Freddy Fazbear, which was created by William Afton to hunt down and kill Charlotte Emily.

Twisted Freddy's normal appearance is a large, blank figure resembling Freddy Fazbear. He has a large metal face, a protruding snout, two rounded ears on the sides of his head, and a perpetual smile. Twisted Freddy's crude metal frame is covered with a layer of gelatinous plastic, giving it an organic, almost embryonic, appearance. He has no fur, instead having a sleek, smooth, and featureless head. Twisted Freddy has a filthy, battered black top hat. His torso is connected to the head by a wide neck. Twisted Freddy has chest plates, which looks like sharp, uneven metal teeth.

When Twisted Freddy's illusion disc activates, he smooths over, becoming less crude. He has a pitch-black top hat perched on his head and cocked slightly to one side, giant cheeks, and a button nose. Twisted Freddy’s head is lively and full of movement, covered in wavy brown fur and bouncy cheeks. He’s also somewhat disjointed, as though every part of his face is moving independently. Twisted Freddy’s head can fold outward, his python-like jaw making motions of chewing and his cheeks and chin dislocating. His mouth is a vortex of fur, teeth, and wire. He also has claws. Twisted Freddy's mouth is unhinged and swings unnaturally. Towards the end of the story, his shiny blue eyes turn a searing red color.

The interior of Twisted Freddy is large enough to hold an adult inside. The captive's limbs are inside the animatronics'. Springlocks restrain them and attempting to move could set them off, but this can be avoided if the occupant is careful and know what they are doing. The twisted animatronics kill by setting off the springlocks. Twisted Freddy’s eyes can roll fully back and look at his captive.
